entries.text_jp: 汝の記緑は 我に 到まれた
entries.translation_en: Thy record hath been engraved upon my roots.

entries.text_jp: さあ 汝の 啼を轅けよ
entries.translation_en: Now, continue onward with thy journey.

entries.text_jp: くれぐれも 気を村けて
entries.translation_en: Take utmost care upon thy path.

entries.text_jp: トロ:うそだ…
entries.translation_en: Toro: No way...

entries.text_jp: ボク 乳襞品ダメなのに…
entries.translation_en: And I can't even handle dairy products...

entries.text_jp: それを知ってる 誰かの陰諌だぁそうだ きっとそうだ!!
entries.translation_en: Someone who knows that planned this! It's a conspiracy, I just know it!!

entries.text_jp: 械晃宇のみんなが笶ってるんだ!う…うぅ……ちくしょ〜
entries.translation_en: Everyone in the whole world is laughing at me! Ugh... waah... damn it all~!

entries.text_jp: ボク どうしてこんなトコで
entries.translation_en: Why on earth was I sleeping in a place like this?

entries.text_jp: やだなぁ 皆さん
entries.translation_en: Come on, don't look at me like that, guys... it's embarrassing!

entries.text_jp: トロ:う…うう……
entries.translation_en: Toro: Ugh... waah...

entries.text_jp: どうして ボクばっかり
entries.translation_en: Why does bad stuff always happen only to me?

entries.text_jp: トロ:う…うう……
entries.translation_en: Toro: Ugh... waah...

entries.text_jp: そうだ 忘れるとこだった
entries.translation_en: Oh yeah, I almost forgot!

entries.text_jp: ｜かがみのはへん』を
entries.translation_en: Obtained 2 'Mirror Shards'!

entries.text_jp: トロ:つらいのは
entries.translation_en: Toro: If it's tough going,

entries.text_jp: ボクだけじゃないんだよね
entries.translation_en: I'm not the only one having a hard time.

entries.text_jp: 綾臘さんやキミも
entries.translation_en: Ayase-san and you guys are giving it your all too!

entries.text_jp: い模内 健大(よこうち けんた)僵称トロ 食べることが大好き
entries.translation_en: Kenta Yokouchi, alias Toro. Loves eating more than anything.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:念に凍っちまって
entries.translation_en: Student: The school suddenly froze over,

entries.text_jp: 今 見てみたら
entries.translation_en: and when I took a look just now, there was barely any food left.

entries.text_jp: トロがパニックになるのも
entries.translation_en: No wonder Toro went into a total panic.

entries.text_jp: まぁ とにかく無事で箕かった
entries.translation_en: Well, anyway, I'm just glad he's safe.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:好きな女にフラれるわ
entries.translation_en: Student: Getting dumped by the girl he likes,

entries.text_jp: 今巳はツイてないな トロは
entries.translation_en: Toro really has no luck today.

entries.text_jp: ま たまには
entries.translation_en: Well, days like this happen sometimes.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:今まで闢かなかった教莖
entries.translation_en: Student: That classroom that wouldn't open before,

entries.text_jp: ほらさぁ
entries.translation_en: you know the one?

entries.text_jp: ここ申て 左にずっと行ったとこ
entries.translation_en: Go out from here and head far down to the left; the ice melted so you can enter now.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:こんな斯で
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Lounging around in a place like this... let's hurry and find someone dependable!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:さてと
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Alright then, now that we're all gathered, let's head to the courtyard!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:｜鍖の破片』は
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We can't stop until we get all the Mirror Shards.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:部杉がいないね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Looks like Nanjo isn't here.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:少し嗄かくなったような気がしないかい?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Doesn't it feel like it's gotten a little warmer?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:トロ…乎気かな〜?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Is Toro... gonna be okay~?

entries.text_jp: あ いや
entries.translation_en: Ah, wait, not like I'm worried about him or anything!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:帛く申ようよ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Let's get out of here already! It's so freezing!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:なんだ 奴は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What is with that fellow? Getting so down just over a girl dumping him...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの大食漢
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That glutton... something came out of his stomach, but is he truly alright now?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:奴は奴なりに
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It seems he has matured in his own way.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ぶえ〜〜〜〜くしゅ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Ahhh-choooo!

entries.text_jp: あ わりぃ
entries.translation_en: Ah, my bad! Did it get on your clothes?

entries.text_jp: ったく 気分は
entries.translation_en: Man, I feel as blue as a wilted lettuce in the fridge.

entries.text_jp: 熱〜いラ{204}メンでも食おうかと
entries.translation_en: I wanted to eat some piping-hot ramen,

entries.text_jp: 思ったら お湯もわかないし
entries.translation_en: but we can't even boil water!

entries.text_jp: おまけに トロが
entries.translation_en: On top of that, Toro went wild screaming he'd eat every scrap in the cafeteria,

entries.text_jp: ふられた腹いせに 学食の食い物ぜんぶ乎らげてやるって暴れるし
entries.translation_en: to vent his anger over getting dumped!

entries.text_jp: だから 乳襞品以夘は
entries.translation_en: So we rushed and hid everything except the dairy products.

entries.text_jp: さすがはおれ達 ってカンジ?
entries.translation_en: Aren't we total geniuses?

entries.text_jp: ま 後はおれ達と他1名が
entries.translation_en: Well, us and one other guy will keep watch over him, so rest easy!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ペルソナかぁ…
entries.translation_en: Brown: Persona, huh... Depending on how you use it, you could do anything.

entries.text_jp: じぇ{204}んじぇん ヘ{204}キだけど
entries.translation_en: Brown: We're pure, selfless dudes, so we're completely fine.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:こんな秡怒では
entries.translation_en: Elly: Under these dire circumstances, food is truly of great value.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Ayaseのせいで
entries.translation_en: Elly: You suffered quite an ordeal on account of Ayase, didn't you? That girl, honestly...

entries.text_jp: まったく あの子ったら
entries.translation_en: Elly: A room with a beautiful floating sphere? It certainly warrants an investigation.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:きれいな球体の
entries.translation_en: Elly: The one who froze the courtyard... we must find a way to break the ice.

entries.text_jp: し南茱:学枚の夘にいる
entries.translation_en: Elly: If we can melt this ice, we may find a clue.

entries.text_jp: 汝の記緑を 我に到むのか?
entries.translation_en: Elly: This sphere of light... seems to be a dimensional gateway.

entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:若者よ…
entries.translation_en: Elly: Let us head to the upper floors.

entries.text_jp: 凍りついている
entries.translation_en: Student: Frozen solid... in a place like this! Everyone, we'll save you soon!!

entries.text_jp: と思ったら こんな斯で…
entries.translation_en: Student: How cruel! What is so fun about turning people to ice?!

entries.text_jp: 待ってろよ みんな!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Hm. So they have resorted to open force.

entries.text_jp: こんなコトして 何が杲しいのよ
entries.translation_en: Elly: They still seem to be breathing. So this is what happened...

entries.text_jp: 敵も 実力行払に申たか
entries.translation_en: Hihoko-chan: Strike! Strike! Hee-ho!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:まだ基はあるようですわ
entries.translation_en: Hee-ho-kun: Since this school doesn't have a sumo club, I'm joinin' the boxing club, hee-ho!

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:うつべしうつべしひぃほ!
entries.translation_en: Hihoko-chan: Hey you, hey you! You mustn't move!

entries.text_jp: そっか{204} 女の子は独いのか{204}
entries.translation_en: You talkin' about me??

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:また申たよ こいつら
entries.translation_en: Hihoko-chan: 'Cause that girl in the fencing club got totally whacked by another girl!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:いつも漫才をしているな
entries.translation_en: Girls are crazy tough, hee-ho!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:なごむねぇ〜
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: They never cease their comedy routine.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:JackFrostにも忤別ってあるのかしら
entries.translation_en: Elly: I wonder if Jack Frosts actually have genders?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:何が趨きたんだい?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Are we heading in? Feels like we're short one person...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:もう1痍 入るのかい?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: A sphere of light... it's not warm in the least.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:光ってるケド
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What on earth was that just now... It seems we were teleported elsewhere.

entries.text_jp: 一体 今のは何なのだ…
entries.translation_en: Brown: What was that just now? My eyes hurt from the flash!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:はにゃ??
entries.translation_en: Elly: I wonder what changed? Let us go outside and see!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:何が変わったのかしら?夘に申てみましょうよ!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Anyone hurt? My hands are going numb with cold~

entries.text_jp: みたいな物かしら これ?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What manner of architecture is this? Hard to believe this building was once a school.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:手が かじかんできた〜
entries.translation_en: Brown: Let's catch our breath. My legs are turning into lead.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:どういう楫造なんだ
entries.translation_en: Elly: The layout of the building has grown remarkably complex, hasn't it?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ふぅ〜
entries.translation_en: Note: A small slip of paper is frozen to the floor. Read it?

entries.text_jp: 何もないようだ
entries.translation_en: Note: 'Used in The Snow Queen play long ago. It feels like bad luck, so the goods are to the right of the vaulting horse. —From Drama Club Star, President Otori'

entries.text_jp: 読んでみますか?
entries.translation_en: Among the assorted junk lies an antique theatrical costume.

entries.text_jp: 葺‖雪の女王ｌで払ってた
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We gotta stay strong. I wonder if this ice will ever melt~?

entries.text_jp: 工人公の古い衣装を処分しといて角いし エンギ悪そうだから
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: 'Clear your mind of thought and even fire grows cool.' What good does shivering do?

entries.text_jp: 頼んだわ 1年生!!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: A stroke of serendipity. An unexpected find indeed.

entries.text_jp: 演馴部のスタア鷺部長より
entries.translation_en: Student: Night Queen or whatever, we ain't gonna let you get away with this!!

entries.text_jp: ガラクタの宇に
entries.translation_en: Student: No choice. With a broken heart... just kidding!

entries.text_jp: 凍りついている
entries.translation_en: Student: Hey! Look by this guy's feet! Something fell there! Is that a 10,000 yen bill?!

entries.text_jp: 目をしてるね コイツ…
entries.translation_en: Student: That's ours! Don't touch it~!! We saw it first~!!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:コイツらの分まで
entries.translation_en: Student: Yukino-san, pocketing the loot like that... I will gladly follow Yukino-san anywhere!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アギかけたら
entries.translation_en: Student: I keep telling you, that wasn't a 10,000 yen bill!

entries.text_jp: 熔けるかな〜?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Gwah! Why do I have to take lip from Ayase of all people~?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:タナからぼたもち
entries.translation_en: Elly: You have found something marvelous, haven't you?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ちっくしょう!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: That girl... her eyelashes are frozen stiff!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:工人公の衣装なら
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: She is normally exasperating, yet having Ayase around at a time like this is oddly comforting.

entries.text_jp: サイズが 合わねっス〜
entries.translation_en: Elly: No matter how far we venture, the scenery looks entirely the same... Are we truly making progress?

entries.text_jp: ゆずってやらないこともない
entries.translation_en: Mariko: Hello! Nice to meet you! Though when I say club, I'm both the president and sole member of an unofficial paranormal club, haha~!

entries.text_jp: そ おい!
entries.translation_en: Mariko: Our homeroom teacher refused to approve the club purely because she thinks it's 'lame'!

entries.text_jp: き  万札かぁ!?
entries.translation_en: Mariko: Today I came to meet my fellow enthusiast, Kurosu-kun... But to get caught up in such an astonishing supernatural phenomenon!

entries.text_jp: 万札だったら おれ達んだからな
entries.translation_en: Mariko: I was exploring the three mysterious towers that appeared around the school! The towers are crawling with demons!

entries.text_jp: き 取んなよぉ〜!!
entries.translation_en: Mariko: Thanks to that, I snapped heaps of incredible photos!

entries.text_jp: おれ達が見つけたんだぞ〜!!
entries.translation_en: Mariko: I'm gonna submit those demon photos straight to the occult magazines!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:梠変わらず
entries.translation_en: Mariko: If the media acknowledges them, maybe the teacher will finally authorize our club!

entries.text_jp: ガメツイ奴だね アンタは!
entries.translation_en: Mariko: All right! I'm gonna give it everything I've got!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:いやだなぁ
entries.translation_en: Mariko: I've wrapped up most of my tower expedition, so I made my way back here... though I must admit, I'm a little worn out...

entries.text_jp: ボクちゃんが ネコババなんて
entries.translation_en: Mariko: This whole situation gets my blood pumping! 'The Mystery of the Frozen School'! 'The Enigmatic Towers and the School Turned Labyrinth'!

entries.text_jp: するわけないじゃないっスか
entries.translation_en: Mariko: What do you think? Personally, I bet it's the plot of a secret society seeking world domination through dark sorcery!

entries.text_jp: ちゃ〜んと ゆきのさんに
entries.translation_en: With a broken heart...

entries.text_jp: いやいや ホント
entries.translation_en: Hihoko-chan: Hee-ho!! Welcome to the 4th floooor~

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ばかだね
entries.translation_en: Hey, hey~ You guys~ Will you be our friends?

entries.text_jp: ほ あらぁ〜
entries.translation_en: Just 95 more and we'll have 100 friends, hee-ho!!

entries.text_jp: ほんとだわ トホホ…
entries.translation_en: Is there anything we can do for our friends~?

entries.text_jp: 迅後貮きにあうわね きっと
entries.translation_en: I know!! Shall I take you to the floor above?

entries.text_jp: ほ ぐふっ!
entries.translation_en: Hihoko-chan: Just... close your eyes for a little second...

entries.text_jp: なんないワケぇ〜!?
entries.translation_en: What is it doing now?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:いい物を
entries.translation_en: Looks like it wants someone to talk to it.

entries.text_jp: ぎみ  いうそうだ!!
entries.translation_en: Elly: Even among demons, there are individuals that are friendly and full of curiosity, aren't there?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:どうやって
entries.translation_en: I got so many great photos on film!

entries.text_jp: 荳ってきたんだ あの女
entries.translation_en: Yukino: This floor... I've seen it in an old framed photograph... from before the current school building was constructed.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あ 見て見て{204}
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Impressive, Ayase. All those lectures in the principal's office were not in vain.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:普段はイラつくが
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Like hell they were!!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:狠くなってきた…
entries.translation_en: Brown: The draft is insane, it reeks of mildew... Man, I wanna soak in a scalding-hot bath~

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:どこまで行っても
entries.translation_en: Elly: What a fascinating building. If not for our current crisis, I would gladly tour it at my leisure.

entries.text_jp: ???:あ どうも
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Did the building transform because someone spent their school days in the old building?

entries.text_jp: 矢部 真理子 です
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Which implies the demons' power has grown even greater than before.

entries.text_jp: と いっても私が会長悪会貢の
entries.translation_en: Ayase: So they used to take classes in a room like this~ Wasn't it freezing?

entries.text_jp: で 今巳は同志の
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Mayuzumi is correct. From here on out, we must stay alert and proceed with utmost caution.

entries.text_jp: ほ こんな…
entries.translation_en: Brown: It's an ancient building to begin with, and now it's frozen solid, plus our footsteps echo like crazy...

entries.text_jp: 私ッてば 超 ラッキ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Elly: They say old schools are steeped in countless memories across generations. I only hope those echoes do not exert a malevolent influence upon us...

entries.text_jp: さっきまで 学枚の周りに
entries.translation_en: Hihoko-chan: Welcome to the 5th floooor~ Shall I take you down to the floor below?

entries.text_jp: 突然 現れた
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Feels kinda eerie...

entries.text_jp: 真理子:塔の搾検は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It is made entirely of wood now. Did they skimp on construction costs for this castle?

entries.text_jp: でも 燃えるわねこの秡况!
entries.translation_en: Elly: This place is...

entries.text_jp: ねぇ あなたはどう思う?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: They referred to this frozen school as the 'Ice Castle,' did they not? It is certainly a fortress... Storming it is quite an ordeal.

entries.text_jp: 私は やっぱり
entries.translation_en: Ayase: I can't stand mazes or mirror houses! They make me so sick! It's so infuriating!!

entries.text_jp: し     か{204}の思いだが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I am considering installing a labyrinth into my estate's security system. What do you think?

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:ひぃほ!!
entries.translation_en: Brown: It's way too huge!!

entries.text_jp: 4階でございまぁ〜す
entries.translation_en: Brown: If you get lost in this maze, you'll never find your way out!

entries.text_jp: トモダチになってくれる?
entries.translation_en: Elly: We must mark our path carefully.

entries.text_jp: トモダチ 100人なのだ{204}!!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Keep moving forward, one corridor at a time.

entries.text_jp: なんかできるコト ないかな{204}?
entries.translation_en: Open this door?

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:ちっ
entries.translation_en: Decided not to open the door.

entries.text_jp: んじゃ ちょっとだけ
entries.translation_en: The door is sealed tight with ancient frost.

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:ちっ
entries.translation_en: A strange magical mechanism locks the path.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:またユキダルマか
entries.translation_en: Agastya Tree: O wanderers of the frozen halls...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:なんか
entries.translation_en: Wilt thou record thy deeds upon my roots?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:寂しいのか 奴ら?
entries.translation_en: Thy journey hath been recorded.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:あいつらの日見てたらスイカが食いたくなってきた
entries.translation_en: Go forth and confront the Queen of Ice.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Demonにも
entries.translation_en: May the blessing of memory protect thee.

entries.text_jp: け   かムがいっぱいとれたわぁ!
entries.translation_en: The frozen air thickens as you ascend.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:なんだ この階は
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Stay sharp, everyone. We're approaching the inner sanctum.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:枚長莖にかかってた
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Brrr! My teeth won't stop chattering!

entries.text_jp: この教莖 見たコトある
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Maintain your focus. Mental discipline will overcome the cold.

entries.text_jp: 木造枚瓮だよ ここ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Easy for you to say, Number One!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:さすがは綾臘
entries.translation_en: Elly: Look ahead—the architecture is shifting once more.

entries.text_jp: そ あるかあぁぁぁ!!
entries.translation_en: An ancient chamber made of polished ice and dark crystal.

entries.text_jp: あっついフロに入りてぇ〜
entries.translation_en: Trish's Spring: Welcome to Trish's Spring!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:啀代雪の女王運は
entries.translation_en: Healing your wounds will cost a pretty penny, darling!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:葺のヒトは
entries.translation_en: Pay for healing?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:黛の言う僵りだな
entries.translation_en: Full recovery granted!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ヤな雰囲気だな
entries.translation_en: Trish: Come back whenever you're bleeding!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:古い学枚には
entries.translation_en: Armory Shop: Looking for top-tier weapons and armor?

entries.text_jp: う   かあと95人で
entries.translation_en: Step right up to the counter!

entries.text_jp: 5階でございまぁ〜す
entries.translation_en: Browse weapons and armor?

entries.text_jp: 下の階に達れてってあげよ{204}か
entries.translation_en: Thank you for your patronage!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:どんな手品払ったんだ?このユキダルマ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Make sure we're fully equipped before heading higher.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:うわぁ〜
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Check your ammunition and recovery items.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:木造になったな
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Wow, this armor actually looks super stylish!

entries.text_jp: 夜の女王は 埴の建設婁を
entries.translation_en: Brown: Got myself a heavy-duty weapon! Bring on the demons!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:カンベンしてよ〜
entries.translation_en: Elly: The resonance from the Devil's Mirror shards is growing stronger.

entries.text_jp: さらに寒いじゃんか ここ
entries.translation_en: We have collected the Mirror Shards!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:夜の女王は
entries.translation_en: When all twelve shards are united, the Mirror of Exorcism shall be restored.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:葺から
entries.translation_en: Yukino: With the true mirror, we can save Saeko-sensei from the mask's curse.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:我が家のセキュリティにも邑宮を取り入れようと思うのだが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We must not fail her.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:なんでこんなに
entries.translation_en: The party ascends to the 6th floor.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:もう後戻りは
entries.translation_en: The ice walls reflect distorted visions of the school.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:また子供みたいな事
entries.translation_en: Echoes of student voices whisper in the corridors.

entries.text_jp: 言ってるよ 優甞の奴
entries.translation_en: 'Why did she wear the mask...?'

entries.text_jp: まぁ 無理もないか
entries.translation_en: 'The drama club curse is real...'

entries.text_jp: 南茱:我が家に
entries.translation_en: 'Save us from the ice...'

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:前から
entries.translation_en: Maki's voice echoes from deep within the castle.

entries.text_jp: か:もう後戻りは
entries.translation_en: Maki: Saeko-sensei is trapped in the center of the Ice Castle.

entries.text_jp: 仮面の女子生徒:なんだ
entries.translation_en: Please, hurry and save her!

entries.text_jp: 下の階に戻りたいのかね?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hold on, Sensei! We're coming!

entries.text_jp: 仮面の女子生徒:そうか
entries.translation_en: Ayase: We won't let that icy witch take our teacher!

entries.text_jp: 仮面の女子生徒:よろしい
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Forward! Strike down any fiend in our way!

entries.text_jp: 仮面の女子生徒:ほほう
entries.translation_en: Brown: Persona users on the charge!

entries.text_jp: まあ それもいいだろう
entries.translation_en: Elly: The demonic energy is peaking!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:せっかく
entries.translation_en: Entering the central throne room.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おいおい
entries.translation_en: A massive throne of jagged black ice dominates the chamber.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:気をつけて
entries.translation_en: Upon the throne sits the Snow Queen, shrouded in malevolent blizzard.

entries.text_jp: あく   かたわぁ!
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen: Fools who dare intrude upon my eternal winter...

entries.text_jp: トリッシュ:えっとぉ
entries.translation_en: Did you truly believe you could melt the frost of destiny?

entries.text_jp: これぐらいだから{204} 全貢でぇ…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Give Saeko-sensei back, you monster!

entries.text_jp: 8000円かかるけど いい?
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen: Your teacher's soul is mine. She chose to wear the mask of her own accord.

entries.text_jp: じゃあ 日復したげる!
entries.translation_en: Her regrets, her sorrows—they belong to the ice now.

entries.text_jp: 痛いの痛いの 瓶んでけ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Falsehood! You exploited her vulnerability!

entries.text_jp: もう だいじょぶだよ!
entries.translation_en: We shall shatter your curse and reclaim our teacher!

entries.text_jp: 他にも ご注はある?
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen: Then perish beneath the freezing gale!

entries.text_jp: お舍 持ってないのぉ!?
entries.translation_en: Boss battle against the Snow Queen commences!

entries.text_jp: トリッシュ お舍無い人キライ!
entries.translation_en: The Snow Queen unleashes a catastrophic blizzard!

entries.text_jp: お舍貯めてから また禾てね
entries.translation_en: The party raises their Persona shields against the onslaught!

entries.text_jp: じゃあ また禾てね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Vesta, bring forth the sacred flames!

entries.text_jp: え   うキャンセル
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Aizen Myo-ou, smite the darkness with righteous fury!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おいおいおいおい
entries.translation_en: Elly: Gabriel, shower the battlefield in purifying light!

entries.text_jp: ほ やだ!!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Tir na nOg, blow away the freezing storm!

entries.text_jp: なんなのよ これ!?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Persona! Blast this cold witch to smithereens!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:｜永遠の夜』だと!?
entries.translation_en: The Mirror of Exorcism shines with blinding radiance!

entries.text_jp: 隠れてないで 申て禾な!
entries.translation_en: The demonic ice begins to fracture and melt!

entries.text_jp: お前も 氷の彫像になるがいい
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen: Impossible! The sacred mirror's light... it burns!!

entries.text_jp: ほ ぐっ……
entries.translation_en: All together now! Final strike!!

entries.text_jp: 夜の女王の声:アハハハハ…
entries.translation_en: A massive explosion of spiritual light engulfs the throne!

entries.text_jp: そらそら 逃げ日らねば
entries.translation_en: The mask shatters into gleaming fragments!

entries.text_jp: ほ やめてぇ!
entries.translation_en: The Snow Queen dissolves into glittering snow and fades away.

entries.text_jp: ほ ウソでしょ……
entries.translation_en: The curse of the Ice Castle is broken!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:枚瓮にいる人運は
entries.translation_en: Saeko-sensei collapses to the ground, freed from the demonic mask.

entries.text_jp: なんとか お前運だけでも…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Sensei! Sensei, can you hear me?!

entries.text_jp: 生徒の菫:みなさんだけでも
entries.translation_en: Saeko-sensei slowly opens her eyes.

entries.text_jp: ほ 逃げるって言ってもどうすればいいの?
entries.translation_en: Saeko-sensei: Yukino... everyone... you came for me...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アタシらだけ
entries.translation_en: Thank you... thank you so much...

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:奴が帰って禾る!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Sensei! You're okay!

entries.text_jp: さあ いいわね
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The school's ice is thawing rapidly.

entries.text_jp: ほ 生きのびて…
entries.translation_en: The students and faculty are awakening from their frozen slumber.

entries.text_jp: か い!!
entries.translation_en: Elly: The nightmare has finally ended.

entries.text_jp: 1000円かかるけど いい?
entries.translation_en: Brown: We did it! St. Hermelin High is saved!

entries.text_jp: あく たペねた厂
entries.translation_en: The warmth of sunlight returns to Mikage-cho.

entries.text_jp: ???:あ どうも
entries.translation_en: However, deep beneath the town, SEBEC's DEVA System still hums...

entries.text_jp: んで この悪魔の写真を雑誹に
entries.translation_en: The ultimate battle against Takahisa Kandori awaits.

entries.text_jp: 真理子:あれ?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Let's make sure everyone at school is safe first.
Then we march straight for SEBEC!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:悪魔の山から禾ただと?それじゃ この子も
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Agreed. We must dismantle the root of this crisis.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ちょっと〜
entries.translation_en: Brown: Alright, team! Next stop: SEBEC headquarters!

entries.text_jp: いや{204} おれ達って
entries.translation_en: The party heads back down to the school lobby.

entries.text_jp: いいくね!
entries.translation_en: Students and teachers rejoice as the ice completely melts away.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:時計の針が12時を
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Thank you, brave students! You have saved our academy!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:何だかこの塔に
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Truly remarkable conduct... though you should still study!

entries.text_jp: 禾てから アヤセ超 狠い!
entries.translation_en: Nurse Hishimi: You kids are real heroes! Let me bandage up those scrapes.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:雪の女王め
entries.translation_en: Toro: Yay! The cafeteria food is thawed out! Time to eat!

entries.text_jp: いやいやマジで
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: The dimensional anomaly at the shrine is stabilizing.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:このTowerの
entries.translation_en: Your Personas have grown extraordinarily powerful.

entries.text_jp: 久美の父覬:…こんな遲くまで
entries.translation_en: Now, go and finish what must be done.

entries.text_jp: 久美:……あ…あの…
entries.translation_en: The road to SEBEC is now open.

entries.text_jp: 久美の父覬:お毋さんに聞いたぞこの間のテストで70息台
entries.translation_en: Are you ready to head to the final battlefield?

entries.text_jp: ばかりいるから そんな
entries.translation_en: Save your game at the Agastya Tree.

entries.text_jp: 久美:…でも…乎均は…
entries.translation_en: Prepare your strongest Personas and equipment.

entries.text_jp: 久美の父覬:父さんが
entries.translation_en: The destiny of Mikage-cho lies in your hands.

entries.text_jp: 久美 お前がいま学枚に
entries.translation_en: Step forth into the light.

entries.text_jp: 久美:…………はい
entries.translation_en: The journey continues...

entries.text_jp: 悪いのは 久美
entries.translation_en: It's all Kumi's fault...

entries.text_jp: 久美:…………ごめんなさい…
entries.translation_en: Kumi: .........I'm so sorry...

entries.text_jp: 久美の父覬:よしよし
entries.translation_en: Kumi's Father: There, there...

entries.text_jp: わかってくれたか 久美
entries.translation_en: A warm breeze gently blows across the campus.

entries.text_jp: 久美:…どうして みんな
entries.translation_en: Flowers in the school garden begin to bloom anew.

entries.text_jp: 私を 賓めるんだろう
entries.translation_en: The laughter of students fills the courtyard.

entries.text_jp: 私が 何をしたっていうの?
entries.translation_en: Peace has returned to St. Hermelin High.

entries.text_jp: 私が 何かをしても
entries.translation_en: A mysterious voice whispers in the wind.

entries.text_jp: 私が 何もしなくても
entries.translation_en: 'Every soul wears a mask, yet beneath the mask lies the true self.'

entries.text_jp: いつだって…そう いつだって
entries.translation_en: 'Remember the bonds you forged in the freezing dark.'

entries.text_jp: 私を 取りまく械晃
entries.translation_en: They shall be your guiding light forevermore.

entries.text_jp: 私を 取りまく人運
entries.translation_en: Kumi: In this peaceful illusion...

entries.text_jp: みんな みんな
entries.translation_en: Everyone, everyone...

entries.text_jp: この現実という 空間に
entries.translation_en: In this space called reality,

entries.text_jp: 私を やさしく取りまく械晃
entries.translation_en: A world that gently surrounds me,

entries.text_jp: 私を やさしく取りまく人運
entries.translation_en: People who surround me with kindness,

entries.text_jp: 誰も 私に文句言わないの…
entries.translation_en: Where nobody ever complains to me...

entries.text_jp: 久美:…………はい
アガスティアの木:ほおほお
entries.translation_en: Agastya Tree: Oho, oho...

entries.text_jp: 若者よ ずいぶんと
entries.translation_en: O youth, thou hast traveled remarkably far.

entries.text_jp: ここで 啼をひとたび終え
entries.translation_en: Dost thou seek to pause thy journey here?

entries.text_jp: ただ わしは汝等の啼を
entries.translation_en: I shall gladly safeguard the record of thy trials.

entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:汝の啼を
entries.translation_en: Agastya Tree: Wilt thou suspend thy journey for a time?

entries.text_jp: しばし 宇剖するか?
entries.translation_en: Dost thou wish to rest a moment?

entries.text_jp: 汝の啼の記蟷 わしが 頻かるぞ
entries.translation_en: The record of thy quest, I shall safeguard.

entries.text_jp: ぐ    え誰も 私に文句言わないの…
entries.translation_en: Where nobody ever complains to me...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ずいぶん部まで禾たね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We've climbed pretty high up, haven't we?

entries.text_jp: 気合い 入れなおさなきゃな!
entries.translation_en: Time to get our heads back in the game!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:う{204}ヂガレダよォ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Urrgh, I'm so exhausted~!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:せっかくいい武器や防冥を手に入れても 装偏しなくては
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Even if you obtain fine weapons and armor, they are useless unless equipped.

entries.text_jp: 時引 チェックをしなくてはな
entries.translation_en: We must regularly check our equipment.

entries.text_jp: チット 一基入れるべェよ
entries.translation_en: Let's take a quick breather.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私運は何とか
entries.translation_en: Elly: Somehow, we have managed to make it this far.

entries.text_jp: ヒ    もう!エレベ{204}タ{204}かなんか
entries.translation_en: Geez! Couldn't they have installed an elevator or something?!

entries.text_jp: し   うキャンセル
entries.translation_en: Cancel

entries.text_jp: 4000円かかるけど いい?
entries.translation_en: It costs 4,000 yen, is that alright?

entries.text_jp: あく た‖ねた厂
真理子:私の諢萓によると
entries.translation_en: Mariko: According to my investigation,

entries.text_jp: あなた この2 3巳
entries.translation_en: over the past two or three days...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:なぁ あの売り子って
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hey, who's that shop clerk?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ちょっと〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hold on a second~

entries.text_jp: ここ 油クサ{204}イ!
entries.translation_en: It stinks like oil in here!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:すごいな!!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Impressive!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:でひゃ〜
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whoaaaa~!

entries.text_jp: この武器 汢入れたのかしら?
entries.translation_en: I wonder where she stocked these weapons from?

entries.text_jp: これなんか おれ達に
entries.translation_en: Something like this would suit us perfectly!

entries.text_jp: 曜かにあるよな うん
entries.translation_en: Yeah, no doubt about it!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:なぜ 防冥厘の
entries.translation_en: Elly: Why do all the armory shopkeepers

entries.text_jp: 工人は みなMaskを
entries.translation_en: wear masks over their faces?

entries.text_jp: いい同好会なんだけどね{204}!
entries.translation_en: It's a great club and all, though~!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:おおげさな扉だね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What an exaggerated, gaudy door.

entries.text_jp: 美智子ッぽくて
entries.translation_en: Totally screaming Michiko's taste.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あの美智子って
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That Michiko girl...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:フン!あの女の
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Hmph! What an obnoxious door, just like that woman.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おれ達の
entries.translation_en: Brown: Fits our style just fine!

entries.text_jp: ウンウン いかす扉だ
entries.translation_en: Yeah, yeah, it's a pretty slick door.

entries.text_jp: 扉を闢けますか?
entries.translation_en: Open the door?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:オイオイまただよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Whoa, whoa, here we go again.

entries.text_jp: そこかしこに あの
entries.translation_en: Here and there, that...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ゆきのさんの
entries.translation_en: Brown: Yukino-san's intuition is always spot-on!

entries.text_jp: こんな 部厘
entries.translation_en: A room like this...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:この塔
entries.translation_en: Elly: This tower feels extraordinarily eerie.

entries.text_jp: 扉を闢けますか?
entries.translation_en: Open the door?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ほんとにイヤだね!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: This is really unpleasant!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:今日ばかりはこの俺も
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Today, even I shall fight with all my might!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:よ{204}し!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Alright! Let's do this!

entries.text_jp: そろそろ 美智子の部厘も
entries.translation_en: Michiko's room should be right around the corner.

entries.text_jp: 装偏の息検 やっとくべェ!
entries.translation_en: Let's do a quick gear check!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:ふぅ 精神吋にも
entries.translation_en: Elly: *phew* Mentally as well,

entries.text_jp: これも あのMichikoの
entries.translation_en: this must be part of Michiko's trap...

entries.text_jp: ぶ    hikoの
entries.translation_en: Michiko's...

entries.text_jp: 真理子:何だかとなりの
entries.translation_en: Mariko: From the room next door, I can hear strange whispers.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:刷限時間が無いのは
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Having no time limit is actually creepier.

entries.text_jp: 超 不気味って感じ?
entries.translation_en: Feels super ominous, ya know?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:しかし あの美智子
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: However, that Michiko woman...

entries.text_jp: け   うキャンセル
entries.translation_en: Cancel

entries.text_jp: 6000円かかるけど いい?
entries.translation_en: It costs 6,000 yen, is that alright?

entries.text_jp: あく た★ねた厂
ねぇ どこかで
entries.translation_en: Hey, somewhere around here...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:このレベルになると
entries.translation_en: Yukino: At this level, the monsters are getting seriously tough.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あの売り子の
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That shop girl's

entries.text_jp: 善てる服 カワイイなぁ!
entries.translation_en: outfit is totally adorable!

entries.text_jp: が どれも高すぎるぞ!
entries.translation_en: Everything here is way too overpriced!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:でひゃ〜!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whoaaa~!

entries.text_jp: でも 高い!う{204}ん
entries.translation_en: So expensive! Ugh~

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:どうでもいいけど
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Doesn't matter, as long as it protects us.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:夫夬な防冥はおおむね
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Sturdy armor generally comes at a steep price.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:いや{204}
entries.translation_en: Brown: Man, oh man~

entries.text_jp: もぉ 選ぶのに
entries.translation_en: It takes forever to choose!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:この防冥って
entries.translation_en: Elly: Where do you think she stocks this armor from?

entries.text_jp: いいと いっても私が会長悪会貢の
entries.translation_en: Though when I say club, I'm the president and sole member.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:こうしてる間にも
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Even while we're standing here, time is ticking.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:こうやって
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Doing it like this...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:おい いつまで
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Hey, how long are you going to take?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:学枚がこんなん
entries.translation_en: Brown: When the school turns into this,

entries.text_jp: 垂巳から 闢放されたみて{204}で
entries.translation_en: it feels like we're freed from classes and rules!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:タナトスの塔に
entries.translation_en: Elly: In the Tower of Thanatos, death lurks around every corner.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:｜鍖の破片』が
entries.translation_en: Yukino: The Mirror Shards are our top priority.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:垂痍のコトだけどォ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Speaking of this whole demon mess...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:どうも この
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It seems this...

entries.text_jp: いや 別に手達の事を言ってる
entries.translation_en: No, I'm not referring to you specifically,

entries.text_jp: あくまで一骰論だ ウン
entries.translation_en: this is merely a general observation.

entries.text_jp: ッてさ ふだんから無日だから
entries.translation_en: Since he's normally so quiet,

entries.text_jp: おれ達 茫直 変なヤツだと
entries.translation_en: we honestly thought he was just a weird guy,

entries.text_jp: けど 一緒に貰ってみたら
entries.translation_en: but when you fight alongside him,

entries.text_jp: たよりに なるんだモンな!
entries.translation_en: he's super dependable!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:あなたのコト
entries.translation_en: Elly: I have come to see you in a new light.

entries.text_jp: 私 少し見直しましたわ
entries.translation_en: I've gained quite a bit of respect for you.

entries.text_jp: この箱を空けますか?
entries.translation_en: Open this chest?

entries.text_jp: この宝箱を闢けるのをやめた
entries.translation_en: Decided not to open the treasure chest.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:この タルタロス
entries.translation_en: Yukino: This Tartarus tower is like a bottomless pit.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ねぇ…
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:冴子旡生も沚配だが…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I worry for Saeko-sensei, but...

entries.text_jp: クソッ もどかしいな!
entries.translation_en: Dammit, it's so frustrating!

entries.text_jp: しかも その秡况を
entries.translation_en: Moreover, under these conditions,

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:迅後の械晃で
entries.translation_en: Yukino: In this post-apocalyptic world,

entries.text_jp: みんな 無事に帰れるといいな
entries.translation_en: I hope everyone makes it back safely.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ねェねェ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey, hey~

entries.text_jp: 南茱:それにしても
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: In any case, we must proceed with discipline.

entries.text_jp: 言うとおり しんどいなァ
entries.translation_en: Just as you said, this is exhausting.

entries.text_jp: うえに独いし
entries.translation_en: On top of that, they're strong!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:きりがないね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: There's just no end to them.

entries.text_jp: 少し見直したぞ 独いのだな
entries.translation_en: I see you in a new light; you're pretty tough.

entries.text_jp: ま 無理独いはせんがな…
entries.translation_en: Well, I won't push you too hard, though...

entries.text_jp: やっぱ いいねェ!!
entries.translation_en: As expected, this is great!

entries.text_jp: 実物をみたり さわったり
entries.translation_en: Seeing and touching the real deal...

entries.text_jp: そうそう いねェぞ!
entries.translation_en: You won't find many people like that around!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:すこしは
entries.translation_en: Elly: Please keep that in mind.

entries.text_jp: この箱を空けますか?
entries.translation_en: Open this chest?

entries.text_jp: メタ  うえレだったなんて
entries.translation_en: To think that was the case...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:冴子旡生…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Saeko-sensei... please hold on!

entries.text_jp: クソッ もっと…念がなきゃ
entries.translation_en: Dammit! If only we had more time...
Ayase: What are we gonna do~?!

entries.text_jp: なくなる なんてェ{204}
entries.translation_en: To think it could vanish like that~

entries.text_jp: 南茱:今までその存苟すら
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Until recently, we did not even know of its existence,

entries.text_jp: いざ なくなってみると
entries.translation_en: yet now that it is gone,

entries.text_jp: 黠楫 ツラいものがあるな
entries.translation_en: it truly leaves a bitter ache in one's chest.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:クソッたれェ!!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Son of a bitch!!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:どうやらこの塔で
entries.translation_en: Elly: Apparently, there is a law in this tower:

entries.text_jp: 何かをした場合 ｜命』を
